Indostomus crocodilus is a tiny indostomid, 25 to 30 mm long, from southern Thailand and Kelantan state in northeastern Peninsular Malaysia.

Type locality is 'Nae Nam Tod Deng, about 6 kilometers north of Sungai Kolok, Narathiwat Province, Thailand', and it is also known from the Tapi River watershed in Surat Thani province, so it is presumably found throughout southern Thailand.
There are also records from Kelantan state, northeastern Peninsular Malaysia, which shares a border with Narathiwat.
